name: lemo-opuscar
description: A toolbox of film styles made in code for Claude Code: 99 ready to use, and your own. Each style is a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5, with no video model. By Lemomo. · 一套用代码做片的风格工具箱：99 种现成风格，也能做出你自己的

capability_evidence.model-routing: e Opus 5.5, apart from two styles contributed from outside: Memphis Diorama by @EianLu and Crayon World 3D by @2nd1st.

friction.note_en: Some setup. needs git clone (build from source); GUI application
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。需要 git clone (build from source)；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: 99 film styles for your coding agent.
highlights: You need Node 20+, ffmpeg 7+ and Python 3.11+ (or uv); the agent installs the rest.
2026-11-12 · 33 new styles: 99 now, in 15 categories sorted by what the picture looks like, and the gallery in English and Chinese, with a page for every style.
Default output 1920×1080 at 24 fps (some styles set their own frame rate, such as 30 fps); other sizes on request.
2026-10-22 · Make a style your own: change a style or start blank, and keep it.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 99 种影片风格，交给你的编程 agent。挑一个风格，带上你的故事，agent 用代码把整支片做出来。
highlights_zh: 2026-11-12 · 33 种新风格：现在共 99 种，按画面像什么分成 15 类；画廊有中文版和英文版，每个风格都有自己的一页；部分 demo 片重新做了，修了 bug，优化了风格提示词。
默认输出 1920×1080、24 fps（有些风格自带帧率，比如 30 fps），其他尺寸可以指定。
一个问题一个问题定方案。 拿来做什么（做什么片、发在哪个平台，竖屏就用 1080×1920 或 1080×1440；有没有品牌色、logo、字体或固定角色），想改哪里、往哪个方向改，最后起名字。改库里的风格时，它先把风格分成三组讲给你听：放心改（配色、字体、动作快慢、声音、标志镜头）、一改就变味（材质和画法、配色的逻辑、镜头语法）、不能改（风格的本质，改了就是另一个风格）。每…
